Are you customer-focused, commercially minded and comfortable handling a variety of customer requests? As a Commercial Excellence Analyst, you will join an international Customer Information Group within the process industry. In this role, you are the first point of contact for customers, channel partners, prospects and other stakeholders, helping them with questions about products and services. You will work in a dynamic environment where customer service, technical knowledge and collaboration come together. Together with colleagues from different departments, you make sure customers receive the right information and support. What’s your job about? As a Commercial Excellence Analyst, you will handle customer questions and requests through both email and telephone. These may relate to technical or regulatory information, samples, literature and other product-related topics. You make sure every customer enquiry is handled accurately and documented according to the agreed service standards. You will also: Provide excellent customer service and contribute to a positive customer experience. Use your business and process knowledge to continuously improve service levels. Recognize commercial opportunities and act on them when appropriate. Work closely with Product Stewards, Regulatory, Sales and Customer Service teams. Manage a varied and sometimes complex workload, making sound decisions about priorities. Contribute to a collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are encouraged. What skills do you have? A relevant MBO 5 equivalent education. Previous experience in customer service, customer support or a similar role. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and at least one Eastern European language. German is preferred. The ability to communicate clearly and professionally with both customers and internal stakeholders. A commercial mindset and a proactive, go-getter attitude. Good computer skills and experience

working with systems such as CRM, SAP and Microsoft Office. The ability to remain calm under pressure and prioritize effectively. A collaborative mindset and the ability to work with different teams and stakeholders. A customer-focused attitude and an eye for opportunities to improve processes and service. What do you get in return? You can expect a gross hourly salary between €25 and €30, depending on your experience and background. In addition, you will receive: A 13th month 28 vacation days Travel expenses covered A full-time position of 40 hours per week An international working environment where you will work with colleagues from different teams You will be working for an international organization within the process industry that develops and supplies innovative products and solutions for customers around the world. The organization works closely with customers to create value and contribute to a more sustainable future. Within the Customer Information Group, you will be part of a team that provides customers, channel partners and prospects with information about products and services. The team works closely with various departments and combines customer service with technical, regulatory and commercial knowledge.

Understand organizational interdependencies and experience working across functions and cultures. Experience i

high volume operational environments is required. Experience in internal controls through prior audit participation is preferred. Good problem solving, critical thinking skills and managing competing priorities. By nature, this job requires a substantial amount of coordination with a variety of internal- and external stakeholders where accountability and ownership of data and processes are key. Self-motivated with a customer service mindset. What do you get in return? Competitive Salary 13th month Travel and any tunnel costs will be reimbursed 28 vacation days This international organization distinguishes itself through its strong focus on innovation, technological expertise, and sustainable development. By combining knowledge, experience, and a global network, the organization develops high-quality solutions that contribute to the growth and continuity of its customers, partners, and society. Professionals from a wide range of disciplines work closely together within the organization, including supply chain, research and development, manufacturing, engineering, health and safety, sustainability, information systems, finance, and human resources. The combination of diverse backgrounds, areas of expertise, and cultures creates a dynamic working environment in which collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are key.
